name: Framelet Studio
subtitle: Search, clean up and enhance
summary: A fast, private way to go through folders of photos and videos on your Mac, keep the best and clear out the rest. Everything runs on your Mac.
description: Framelet Studio is a Mac app for your folders of photos and videos: browse them, relive your trips on a map, enhance and decorate your shots, pull stills and subjects out of them, and clear out what you don’t need.
There’s nothing to import. Framelet Studio works directly with your folders, and all analysis runs on your Mac, on the Neural Engine.
requires: Apple silicon (M1 or later), macOS 26 Tahoe or later

get.note: Search “Framelet Studio” on the Mac App Store

features.title: All your folders in one place
features.text: Add as many as you like and browse them together, as a grid or on a map.

features.title: Relive the trip
features.text: A colorful route with a numbered pin at every stop, along the real roads if you like. Tilt to see the land and buildings in 3D, or zoom out to the globe.

features.title: Quick preview
features.text: Press Space to open any photo or play any video, with a filmstrip to jump between them.

features.title: Clean up safely
features.text: Marked items go to the Trash together, only when you confirm. Every decision can be undone, and you can see how much space you freed each day.

features.title: Organize in place
features.text: Rename, move and label files, and give folders their own color and icon. Favorites and labels are Finder tags, so they show up in Finder too.

features.title: Extract frames
features.text: Save sharp stills from any video as JPEG copies beside it.

features.title: Set as wallpaper
features.text: Put any photo on your desktop in one step.

pro.name: Framelet Studio Pro
pro.text: A one-time purchase that unlocks Find Duplicates and Framelet Intelligence, all on device. Choose Upgrade to Pro in the toolbar. Bought it before? It unlocks on its own on any Mac signed in with the same App Store account, and Family Sharing is on.

features.title: Find duplicates
features.text: Exact copies, resized copies, bursts and retakes, with the best one to keep suggested and the extras marked in one step.

features.title: Search by content
features.text: Type “dog at the beach” and find it. Framelet Studio reads scenes, objects and text.

features.title: Categories
features.text: People, Animals, Food & Drink, Landscapes, Documents and more, sorted for you.

features.title: Enhance Photo
features.text: One-click fixes for light, color and a level horizon, compared before and after, plus holiday looks and cartoon stickers.

features.title: Extract Subject
features.text: Lift the subject off its background and copy it, share it, or save it as a PNG or a sticker.

privacy.label: Data Not Collected
privacy.text: Framelet Studio has no accounts, no analytics and no tracking. Your photos never leave your Mac.
